proposed_widenings.name: species_trait branching progression mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait requires a build-time choice among mutually exclusive lineage branches, and each chosen branch carries its own later benefits. Existing species traits only support one passive bundle or one activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

proposed_widenings.name: character-level gated non-spell grants
proposed_widenings.justification: The chosen lineage grants additional content specifically at character levels 3 and 5, which current species-trait mechanics cannot stage over progression.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

proposed_widenings.name: rest-replaceable spell-list cantrip selection
proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf does not grant one fixed spell id; it grants a Wizard cantrip choice that can be replaced whenever the character finishes a Long Rest.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

notes: No content/*.dhall was authored because any current encoding would be misleading. The trait needs non-spell branch selection plus progression-gated grants; High Elf also needs replaceable spell-list selection.
